citation: Cao, Fatemi, Fang, Watanabe, Taniguchi, Kaxiras & Jarillo-Herrero, "Magic-angle graphene superlattices: a new platform for unconventional superconductivity", Nature 556, 43 (2018); arXiv:1803.02342v2
license: arXiv.org perpetual non-exclusive license; facts and numbers only, no text or figures reproduced
topic: Shubnikov-de Haas oscillations of a magic-angle twisted bilayer graphene (MA-TBG) device are mapped against carrier density n and magnetic field on the hole side; ns is the density that fills one superlattice band (4 electrons per moiré cell).

facts.text: The Landau fans that start at charge neutrality and at -ns have filling factors -4, -8, -12, ..., as expected from the four-fold spin and valley degeneracy of the single-particle bands.
An extra fan starts at the half-filling insulating state -ns/2, with filling factors -2, -4, -6, ...; it sits directly above the superconducting dome.
This extra fan is already visible at about 1 T.

From the oscillation frequency, the number of degenerate Fermi pockets is M = 4 near charge neutrality and beyond the superlattice gap, but M = 2 for the oscillations that start near the half-filling state; their area follows |n| - ns/2 rather than |n|.
The same Landau-level sequence is seen in two other MA-TBG devices.

ask: Which explanation of the extra Landau fan is consistent with all of these observations?

hypotheses.text: Small Fermi pockets of quasiparticles counted from the half-filling correlated insulator, with half the usual degeneracy; the carriers above the superconducting dome are only |n| - ns/2.
hypotheses.locator: Quantum oscillations (p. 8): small Fermi surfaces from the correlated insulating state; halved degeneracy
hypotheses.reason: 与全部观测一致，即原文结论。

hypotheses.text: Fractional Landau fans of the Hofstadter butterfly of the moiré superlattice.
hypotheses.locator: Quantum oscillations (p. 7): Hofstadter features need fields > 10 T
hypotheses.reason: Hofstadter 分形通常要 10 T 以上才明显，而这个扇在约 1 T 就出现。

hypotheses.text: A doubled unit cell from strain or a charge density wave, which halves the filling factors of the ordinary single-particle bands.
hypotheses.locator: Quantum oscillations (p. 7): would require spin or valley degeneracy to be broken a priori
hypotheses.reason: 晶胞加倍要求事先破缺自旋或谷简并，但从电中性点和 −ns 出发的扇仍是四重简并。

hypotheses.text: The ordinary single-particle Fermi surface of all |n| carriers, with the usual four-fold degeneracy.
hypotheses.locator: Quantum oscillations (p. 8): M = 2 near the correlated state
hypotheses.reason: 半填充附近测得 M = 2，面积随 |n| − ns/2 变化，不是全部载流子的大费米面。

scale.definition: 莫尔晶胞（1.05° 时约 13 nm）
